safeguards.name: Preserve V1 production paths
safeguards.detail: Current admin, map, calendar and feeds remain untouched.

safeguards.name: Preserve IDs and curated records
safeguards.detail: V2 migration must retain stable identity and NYCIF editorial precedence.

safeguards.name: Shadow comparison
safeguards.detail: V2 must compare against V1 before production authority changes.

safeguards.name: Immediate rollback
safeguards.detail: Cutover requires a retained V1 rollback path and explicit approval.
